candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is cryoglobulinemic vasculitis, a specific systemic vasculitis caused by cryoglobulin immune complexes. C001 names cerebral vasculitis (confirmed on angiography) as a manifestation within SSc but omits the cryoglobulinemic etiology entirely. The angiographic finding of cerebral angiitis is a component/manifestation of the underlying cryoglobulinemic vasculitis, not the final diagnostic object. The candidate is therefore a partial parent/component—compatible in family but missing the required etiologic specificity.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies cerebral vasculitis in the context of SSc but does not specify cryoglobulinemic vasculitis as the etiology; cerebral vasculitis is a manifestation/component rather than the final diagnostic entity

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis of cryoglobulinemic vasculitis is not directly supported by explicit cryoglobulin testing results documented in the clinical record; diagnosis appears inferential based on clinical context and exclusion of other causes
Unusual combination of SSc with cryoglobulinemic vasculitis makes this a diagnostically challenging case; absence of cryoglobulin assay results in the record limits full verification
